_comment: Copy to config/models.json (git-ignored), put real keys there, then run: node scripts/setup-models.mjs. Each entry is a TrueForge model-provider manifest (POST /api/v1/settings/model-providers). Then list the model FQNs you want, in priority order, in the VS Code setting forgelight.models (primary first, fallbacks after).
_task_c: For Task C (resilience) set forgelight.models to ["unreachable/broken-model", "ollama/qwen3-6-35b"]: the first model fails to connect, Forgelight retries once with backoff, then falls back to the second model automatically.
_gemini: Free Google AI Studio key (no card). Free tier is about 15 requests/min and 500 requests/day per project for each Flash-Lite model; quota resets at 13:30 IST. Use the native google-gemini provider, not custom: TrueForge only replays Gemini thought signatures through the native provider.
